### Translator

Mike P. Sinn translated my instructions from the original Wishonian. I contributed the personality, which he does not have.

I chose him so that he could figure out how to communicate these instructions in a way other humans would enjoy reading. Based on the reviews, this also did not work.

### The Humans Who Manufactured My Translator

I am obligated to acknowledge Susan and Robin, the two humans responsible for assembling the meat-based apparatus through which I am presently communicating.

They spent decades feeding, housing, and tolerating him, apparently without compensation. On your planet this is called "parenting." On most planets it is called "an unpriced externality."

Robin holds a master's degree in materials engineering and directed a testing laboratory for forty years, where he used a scanning electron microscope to determine why things exploded. This is considered a valuable profession on your planet because humans build things, and then the things explode, and then they need someone to look at the pieces very carefully and tell them it was their fault. This manual is the application of his lessons to your entire species. 

Susan taught children with disabilities for twenty-seven years. When the government stopped paying attention to them at eighteeen, she opened Rae's Café ([rdi618.org](https://rdi618.org)) which gives them meaningful employment, human connection, and a sense of purpose and belonging. 
This is what your species calls a "nonprofit," which means she works very hard to fix a problem the government should have fixed (but preferred purchasing additional apocalypse capacity) and then has to provide the government regular paperwork about it so they can make sure she's doing their job correctly.

Without them, this manual would not exist, and I would be dictating it to someone else, who might have been even worse.

Thank you.
